method: Optional upstream phase assignment; exact per-cadence deadline multisets and all other job fields preserved. Fresh equal-budget optimizer runs with exact polygon acceptance and independent final verification.

checks.alignment_tests: Six targeted tests passed; weekly/monthly deadlines, exact invariants, overlap holes, solar incompatibility, source preservation, ordering and demand matching.
checks.export_invariants: Each generated full preset was round-tripped and verified against its source: geometry unchanged; only first_deadline_hours changed; exact per-cadence deadline multisets preserved.
checks.release_build: passed for job-align, scheduling-graph, schedule, schedule-compare and schedule-playback

limitations: The additional phase slices rotate deadline phases against the same orbit/solar window; they are not propagated future dates or a rolling schedule.
Every phase snapshot starts with empty imagery history. The original five-hour initial buffer is not re-applied after phase rotation.
Due counts are identical but available reward varies because due job identities change; report both absolute reward and reward percentage.
Groups are bounded, same-cadence heuristic clusters, not a global optimum or a guarantee for every day.
The earlier 73.99% replay used a warm-started search. This experiment compares fresh equal-budget runs instead.
